newsitem.title: USA: America Service loses Ga. contract.
newsitem.headline: America Service loses Ga. contract.

text.p: America Service Group Inc said it has lost a contract with the Georgia Department of Corrections to provide medical services to prison inmates.
The company said its current contract with the state will run out next July.

A spokesman for the Georgia corrections department said the company was in the midst of a one-year $60 million contract. America Service took over the contract from another company in the middle of 1995, before it won a full year contract for this year.

The spokesman said the agency was satisfied with the services delivered by the company, but decided to award the contract within the state, with the Medical College of Georgia. The new contract will be about the same sum as the America Service contract, but should result in "eventual cost savings," he said.
